notes: Product Identity Guard. Fixes the root cause of cross-device Product ID collisions: the legacy nextMasterId generator only examined the current device's local Product Master, so a device with an incomplete/stale product list could reissue a PRD number already used elsewhere. New products now receive collision-proof IDs such as PRD-0067-ABCDEF while preserving the familiar sequential prefix. Product Master cloud conflicts are identity-aware: if the same Product ID represents materially different names/SKUs/colours, sync pauses instead of overlaying the records. Adds a guarded repair for the confirmed PRD-0013 collision: restores Grand Cru · Barton 2 to PRD-0013, moves clearly Tolko Ulay Plywood Piece/sheet inventory to a new unique Product ID, normalizes linked operations, saves an audit backup first, and verifies the repaired datasets in cloud. Preserves Build070 lifecycle/tombstone protection, Build068 Hybrid Carpet Tags, and Build067 Cut Piece Return recovery.
